blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trade deal between the Philippines and the United States will focus on energy and food, particularly agricultural products, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said on Friday. US President Donald Trump earlier announced the conclusion of what he described as the “biggest trade deal” his country has ever made with the Philippines. However, details of the agreement have yet to be disclosed.
